notes: GeoTalk 1.9: this update fixes one-way audio on direct internet calls and adds call-back from the call log. ONE-WAY AUDIO FIX — on some phones the person who placed the call heard only their own voice repeated, or nothing of the other side. The app now refreshes its connection addresses at the moment a call actually connects instead of reusing the ones gathered when the call was placed (a waiting call's internet mapping can expire before the other side even answers); the voice path is chosen by real voice — never by the small test pings used to open the path — and stays locked to the path that is actually carrying voice; packets that are the phone's own voice looped back are recognised and dropped instead of played back; and if a voice stream's timing ever slips out of step, the player re-syncs to it instead of discarding it. When both phones share one connection (for example one phone's hotspot), the app now uses the direct local path between them instead of a public address that cannot be reached from inside. Every direct call also records its sent/received voice counts into the problem report, so any remaining audio problem can be pinpointed exactly. CALL-BACK — tap any entry in the Calls tab (incoming, outgoing or missed) to call that person back; an entry whose contact is not saved simply says so. Everything from 1.8 is kept in full: the complete 1.7 feature set with the 1.7 launch problem fixed — push starts safely after the app opens and can never block or break it, faster calls via the remembered proven path and ringing-time connection preparation, Opus HD voice (wideband 16 kHz, adaptive about 16–40 kbps with error correction) that stays clear on slow connections at roughly a tenth of the data, push incoming calls with the full call screen even when the app is closed (this activates as soon as the push service is switched on for your account — no app update will be needed after that), the independent direct-UDP live voice engine between WebRTC and Push-to-Talk, native crash details in problem reports, the call safety guard that resets on every new version, call signaling on its own dedicated thread, proper telephony audio mode with audio focus, incoming calls ring with your default ringtone and vibration, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
